title: Quantitative collinear finiteness and maximal-dimensional simplex rigidity
exact_target: Determine whether every positive-mass n-body system with n≥4 has finitely many central configurations up to the usual symmetries.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002553 (AIM-PHYSICS-0061). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 24.

status_qualification: The source asks for all positive masses, not only generic masses or collinear configurations. The spatial configuration class must be stated; finiteness of normalized labeled configurations without rotation quotient would not be the intended statement. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
